title: Three independent reports of rain
hook: Two stated cases: explore the conditional independence of witness reports.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the conditional independence of witness reports affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the conditional independence of witness reports in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
